description: The backup.finished event, emitted by the backup engine itself (T4) on the way out of a successful run, through the daemon's one publish seam (T6): the file's NAME — never a path, BK12 — with its size and sha256, the migrations applied, the verify level the run's own check reached, the free-space state, and the ledger's reason/actor pair. A subscribed panel refreshes its backup list from this; the payload is ids, enums and numbers only, daemon-wide (no componentRoot — the backup has no project).
